query:
WITH query_embedding AS (
            SELECT value
            FROM embeddings
            WHERE id = $1
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (te.id)
            te.id AS "id!: Uuid",
            te.value <=> qe.value AS "distance!: f64"
        FROM tagged_embeddings te
        CROSS JOIN query_embedding qe
        WHERE te.tag_hash = ANY ($2)
        ORDER BY te.id, "distance!: f64"
        LIMIT $3
